content.json:
## Heimdal LLM gateway: token usage
Source: `llm-emit-token-metric` custom metrics (namespace `heimdal`, table `AppMetrics`) and the APIM LLM gateway log (`ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog`). Metrics and logs lag a few minutes.

content.name: tiles
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize ["Total tokens"]=tolong(sum(Sum)), Users=dcount(User), Models=dcount(Model), Agents=dcount(Agent)
content.title: Totals

content.name: tokens-by-user
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by User
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: Total tokens per user

content.name: tokens-by-user-split
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by User, Name
| order by User asc
content.title: Prompt vs completion tokens per user

content.name: tokens-over-time
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), User
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total tokens over time per user

content.name: user-model-matrix
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by User, Model
| order by User asc, Tokens desc
content.title: Tokens per user and model

content.name: user-model-table
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)), Calls=count() by User, Model
| order by User asc, Tokens desc
content.title: User x model breakdown (metrics)

content.name: model-share
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by Model
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: Token share per model

content.name: tier-user
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by User, Tier
| order by User asc
content.title: Tokens per user and routing tier

content.json:
### Exact per-request usage (LLM gateway log)
The LLM log has no user column. It is joined to `ApiManagementGatewayLogs` on `CorrelationId`, and the APIM subscription name is the user.

content.name: llmlog
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| join kind=inner (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | project CorrelationId, User = ApimSubscriptionId) on CorrelationId
| summarize Requests=count(), Prompt=sum(PromptTokens), Completion=sum(CompletionTokens), Total=sum(TotalTokens) by User, ModelName
| order by Total desc
content.title: Requests and tokens per user and model

content.name: agent
content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| extend User = tostring(Properties["User"]), Model = tostring(Properties["Model"]), Tier = tostring(Properties["Tier"]), Agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"])
| summarize Tokens=tolong(sum(Sum)) by Agent, User, Model
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: Tokens per agent, user and model

content.json:
### Local Ollama via ngrok
Calls the router forwarded to the backend `asgard-ollama` (a model on the demo machine, reached through an ngrok tunnel). Source: `ApiManagementGatewayLogs` (`BackendId`, `BackendTime`, status codes) joined with `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog` (tokens, model) via `CorrelationId`. Empty unless the gateway was deployed with `HEIMDAL_ENABLE_OLLAMA=true`. `BackendResponseCode` 0 / 502 / 504 usually means the laptop or the tunnel is offline.

content.name: ollama-tiles
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ApiId has "bifrost-llm"
| extend Backend = case(BackendId == "asgard-ollama" or BackendUrl has ".ngrok", "local ollama (ngrok)",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry-mai", "foundry mai",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry", "foundry",
                        isempty(BackendId) and isempty(BackendUrl), "not forwarded (gateway)",
                        "other")
| where Backend == "local ollama (ngrok)"
| join kind=leftouter (ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
    | summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), Model = take_any(ModelName) by CorrelationId) on CorrelationId
| summarize ["Local calls"]=count(), Failed=countif(ResponseCode >= 400), Users=dcount(ApimSubscriptionId), Tokens=tolong(sum(Tokens)), ["Avg backend ms"]=tolong(avg(BackendTime)), ["P95 backend ms"]=tolong(percentile(BackendTime, 95))
content.title: Local Ollama totals

content.name: ollama-backend-over-time
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ApiId has "bifrost-llm"
| extend Backend = case(BackendId == "asgard-ollama" or BackendUrl has ".ngrok", "local ollama (ngrok)",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry-mai", "foundry mai",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry", "foundry",
                        isempty(BackendId) and isempty(BackendUrl), "not forwarded (gateway)",
                        "other")
| summarize Calls=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Backend
content.title: Calls per backend over time (local vs Foundry)

content.name: ollama-backend-compare
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ApiId has "bifrost-llm"
| extend Backend = case(BackendId == "asgard-ollama" or BackendUrl has ".ngrok", "local ollama (ngrok)",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry-mai", "foundry mai",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry", "foundry",
                        isempty(BackendId) and isempty(BackendUrl), "not forwarded (gateway)",
                        "other")
| summarize Calls=count(), ["Failed %"]=round(100.0 * countif(ResponseCode >= 400) / count(), 1), ["Avg backend ms"]=tolong(avg(BackendTime)), ["P95 backend ms"]=tolong(percentile(BackendTime, 95)) by Backend
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Backend comparison: calls, failures, latency

content.name: ollama-user-model
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ApiId has "bifrost-llm"
| extend Backend = case(BackendId == "asgard-ollama" or BackendUrl has ".ngrok", "local ollama (ngrok)",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry-mai", "foundry mai",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry", "foundry",
                        isempty(BackendId) and isempty(BackendUrl), "not forwarded (gateway)",
                        "other")
| where Backend == "local ollama (ngrok)"
| join kind=leftouter (ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
    | summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), Model = take_any(ModelName) by CorrelationId) on CorrelationId
| summarize Calls=count(), Failed=countif(ResponseCode >= 400), Tokens=tolong(sum(Tokens)), ["Avg backend ms"]=tolong(avg(BackendTime)), ["Last call"]=max(TimeGenerated) by User=ApimSubscriptionId, Model
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Local Ollama calls per user and model

content.name: ollama-recent
content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
| where ApiId has "bifrost-llm"
| extend Backend = case(BackendId == "asgard-ollama" or BackendUrl has ".ngrok", "local ollama (ngrok)",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry-mai", "foundry mai",
                        BackendId == "asgard-foundry", "foundry",
                        isempty(BackendId) and isempty(BackendUrl), "not forwarded (gateway)",
                        "other")
| where Backend == "local ollama (ngrok)"
| join kind=leftouter (ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange:query}
    | summarize Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), Model = take_any(ModelName) by CorrelationId) on CorrelationId
| project TimeGenerated, User=ApimSubscriptionId, Model, Operation=OperationId, ResponseCode, BackendResponseCode, BackendTime, Tokens, LastErrorReason, LastErrorMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Latest local Ollama calls (troubleshooting)
